foundation.title: Operations start when the foundation is under control.
foundation.intro: This environment prepares the interface, services and security boundaries. No fiscal operation is enabled at this stage.
foundation.operationDescription: The foundation is set up for local validation. Import, calculation, issuance and billing actions remain unavailable until their corresponding modules are implemented.
foundation.preparedDescription: The installable interface, health contracts and asynchronous processing follow independent paths.
foundation.boundaryDescription: There are no documents, amounts, certificates or customer data on this screen.
foundation.integrationNotConfigured: No local API URL is configured for this interface.
foundation.integrationReady: The health check is available when a local API URL is configured.
foundation.integrationUnavailable: The local API URL did not respond to the health check.
foundation.footer: Bun foundation · local validation before any remote environment
